note: Sixteen interleaved pairs on one host, alternating which binary ran first. The parent null broker checksummed each produce batch with a byte-at-a-time CRC32-C table. The candidate folds eight bytes per step and matches the byte table on every length from 0 through 300, plus the Castagnoli check value. Every run acknowledged 20,000 measured records and matched the high watermark. Before median 829,839.65 records/s, after median 888,892.06. Paired mean ratio 1.100, bootstrap 95% CI 1.055 to 1.153. One of sixteen pairs was slower. Client CPU-nanoseconds per record medians were 1,131.33 before and 1,137.73 after (ratio 1.006). This is a null-broker change, not a library change, not a peer comparison, and not a KL09-70 claim.
